title: cipura sabini
intro: Cipura sabini, commonly known as "Queen's Wreath", is a plant species in the family Iridaceae. The health benefits of Cipura sabini include its potential to aid in the treatment of diabetes, as it has been shown to have hypoglycemic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Cipura sabini include iridoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
